<article title="Product care">
Wash technical shells and down jackets on a gentle cycle with a technical-fabric wash, never regular detergent, and tumble dry on low. Down jackets need two or three clean tennis balls in the dryer to restore loft.

Waterproof coatings wear down with use. If water stops beading on a shell, wash it and apply a spray-on re-proofing treatment; this restores the coating without affecting the warranty.

Store sleeping bags and down items uncompressed in a dry place. Long-term compression permanently reduces insulation.

</article>

Customer first name: Felix
<request>
rain gets through
my shell used to keep me dry and now it soaks through at the shoulders after ten minutes.
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Felix,

Thanks for reaching out. When shells stop repelling water, it's often because the waterproof coating has worn down with use. We recommend washing your shell first, then applying a spray-on re-proofing treatment to restore the coating. This should help water bead again without affecting your warranty.

If the issue persists after re-proofing, a specialist will follow up with you to investigate further.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
